headline: Child of jailed Jubo Mohila League leader dies, mother to see body at prison gate

members.title: Child of jailed Jubo Mohila League leader dies, mother to see body at prison gate
members.lead: Sharmin Sultana Shormi, an imprisoned leader of the political activities-banned Jubo Mohila League, has lost her son. He was a child with disabilities. Arrangements are being made to take her to the gate of Kashimpur Women's Central Jail so she can see the body of her son for the last time. The incident came to light after news of her son's death spread on social media. Sharmin Sultana's husband, Shahadat Hossain Nipu, told Prothom Alo at around 11am, “I am not in the state to speak right now. I am at the Kashimpur jail for her parole release. From here, I have been asked to submit an application to the Deputy Commissioner of Gazipur." . Shahadat Hossain said prison authorities informed him that it is not possible to take Sharmin Sultana outside the prison in view of the overall security situation in the country. There are not enough law enforcement personnel to provide her with security. However, arrangements will be made for her to see her deceased son for the last time at the prison gate. Shahadat Hossain further said that the jail authorities informed him that if his wife Sharmin Sultana were taken outside, it would not be possible to provide adequate security. He was also told that there are directives from higher authorities considering security risks regarding granting parole to any prisoner until December. He mentioned that a freezer van carrying the body of the child has left for Kashimpur jail so that the imprisoned mother can see her dead child's face for the last time. . Senior Jail Superintendent (acting) of Kashimpur Women's Central Jail Md Nazrul Islam told Prothom Alo, “Their (Sharmin Sultana and Shahadat Hossain's) child has died. The child had disabilities. An application has been made to us for her to see the deceased child for the last timet. In accordance with prison regulations, arrangements will be made for her to see the child for around two minutes at the prison gate, with security ensured. members.title: Petrol bomb hurled at BNP MP MA Malique's house in Sylhet
members.lead: Miscreants hurled a petrol bomb at the house of Mohammed Abdul Malique, known as MA Malique, a member of parliament (MP) from the Sylhet-3 (Dakshin Surma, Fenchuganj and Balaganj) constituency. At the time, he was at home with his wife and son. The incident took place early Saturday morning in the Tetli area of Dakshin Surma upazila. A section of the house's tin roof was burnt in the fire caused by the petrol bomb. However, security personnel quickly brought the fire under control. . BNP MP MA Malique told Prothom Alo this afternoon that he woke up early in the morning to a loud explosion. When he went outside, he learnt that a petrol bomb had been hurled at his house, setting it on fire. His wife and son were also at home at the time. They too came outside after hearing the noise. MA Malique said he had learnt that the attackers arrived in a human hauler, locally known as laguna. He said they fled immediately after hurling the petrol bomb. Four security personnel at the house quickly brought the fire under control. . Expressing his anger over the incident, MP MA Malique said, "Such an incident is unfortunate. Those who carried out the attack are Sheikh Hasina's supporters. After becoming an MP, I have been working to ensure that everyone can live peacefully in my constituency. I have not made any distinction among people based on their political affiliations. Yet I had to face such an attack." Asked about the incident, Additional Deputy Commissioner (Media) of Sylhet Metropolitan Police Md Afzal Hossain said a preliminary review of the video footage suggested that two people were involved. Police also initially suspect that people of Awami League, which activities are currently banned, may have been involved in the attack.
